messages:
ashok: Heads-up — after the merge (6d12f9 -> main) we're seeing a decode-path perf spike on shortseq traffic. p95 is ~+22%, KV hit rate dropped ~15%. Canary shows a lot of churn at the batch handoff where the attention kernel switches. @maria can you take a quick look?

maria: I replayed a canary trace locally. nvprof and our allocator logs show an extra host->device memcpy between kv-stage and attn kernel for short sequences. It looks like the new kernel selection path picks `attn_transpose_v2` which expects aligned KV layout, and we run `safe_memcopy` before the kernel.

jen: can you paste the perf summary and a short trace snippet?

ashok: perf-summary paste below:

```
perf-summary:
p50 12ms -> 14ms
p95 28ms -> 34ms
kv_hit 98% -> 83%
kernel_choice: attn_transpose_v2 for shortseq
memcpy counts +1 per token
```

sam: this rings a bell — PR #4421 introduced a fused-batching handshake change that added an alignment copy when layout != expected. snippet from that change:

```
if (unaligned) safe_memcopy(src, aligned_buf, bytes);
select_kernel(..., expect_aligned=true);
```

olga: I generated a flamegraph from a failing canary. big red box: `attn_transpose_v2` which then shows a `memcpy` subtree. the older `attn_transpose_v1` path has no memcpy.

jen: let's bisect quickly — if it's the alignment copy we revert it and measure. can someone run a quick git bisect on the canary branch?

perf-bot: CI alert — perf regression detected on main: p95 decode +18% (build 6d12f9 -> 6d13ff). Full CI report: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/12345/console

ashok: starting quick bisect locally: `git bisect start 6d13ff 6d12f9` — marking HEAD bad, 6d12f9 good. will narrow to the exact patch.

maria: if revert reduces memcpy, we should rework alignment: kernel should accept unaligned pointers for shortseq fast path or do on-GPU alignment (no host memcpy). copying host->device for every request is expensive.

sam: i'll try a micropatch that uses the device-side shim to handle unaligned KV layout (branch `no-cpymem-align`). pushing in ~10m and will run the canary.

jen: alternative mitigation: lower the batcher kernel flip threshold for shortseq so we stick to v1 until we have a non-copying path. config tweak suggestion: `batcher.shortseq_flip_threshold = 8` (was 4).

ashok: holding the canary and tagging oncall @olga. :eyes: we should block the rollout until bisect completes.

olga: ack — logs + traces saved to /mnt/perf/3198765432/trace.html and /tmp/flame-3198765432.svg. i'll run the bisect next and report the commit hash.

ashok: thanks all. if the `no-cpymem-align` branch fixes it we can land a safer alignment implementation and then re-enable v2. otherwise we'll revert PR #4421 for the hotfix.

ci-bot: Patch candidate `no-cpymem-align` built: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/12346 — perf run queued.
